name: ZORA community claim allocation to the stateless 0x Settler
summary: ZoraTokenCommunityClaim pays each account's allocation to any _claimTo chosen by that account. Its allocation setter wrote a 5,500,777.45 ZORA allocation for 0x's BaseSettler, a stateless router whose execute runs arbitrary actions for any caller. Once claims opened, an attacker's constructor had the Settler call claim(attacker) and received the whole allocation.

loss.notes: Exact ZORA transfer from the claim contract to the attacker EOA (source-1 receipt log 147), valued at the DefiLlama ZORA quote.

ageReset.description: The setAllocations batch (AllocationsSet log 482) wrote the Settler's 5,500,777.449190208 ZORA allocation, the value necessary to the exploited condition. The claim contract behaves as designed; the later completeAllocationSetup and claimStart opened every allocation at once and only set exposure.

sources.note: Reviewed root cause, first exercise, artifact identity and causal configuration. Source-1 (block 29356088, index 29) is a contract creation by EOA 0xb957ed2f9d104984fc547a26da744cef68a81238. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer): constructor 0x5e33cff6d7461e00c840c1fce3eb01f12c1db2fa calls BaseSettler 0x5c9bdc801a600c006c388fc032dcb27355154cc9 execute((address,address,uint256),bytes[],bytes32) (0x1fff991f) with an action that makes the Settler call ZoraTokenCommunityClaim 0x0000000002ba96c69b95e32caab8fc38bab8b3f8 claim(0xb957ed2f...) (0x1e83409a). The claim contract transfers 5500777449190208000000000 ZORA to the attacker (receipt log 147, Claimed log 146). Verified source (Etherscan V2 getsourcecode chainid=8453, ZoraTokenCommunityClaim): claim(_claimTo) calls _claim(msg.sender, _claimTo), paying accountClaims[msg.sender].allocation once to any recipient. The Settler is a public, stateless action router, so an allocation to it is claimable by anyone. Configuration: Etherscan getLogs AllocationsSet(bytes32[]) (topic 0xbd18231792a7535fff80d85564ce7d95dbdff6819b40ad815711b21a75e6bb49), blocks 0..29356087: the only log whose packed data contains the Settler is log 482 of source-2 (block 29298732, index 80, sent by allocation setter 0x90a5d84059a18c3c962f5101cc3c543b5028c2cb, setAllocations 0x63254547). eth_call allocations(Settler) (0x52a9039c) returns 0 at block 29298731 and 5500777449190208000000000 at 29298732 and 29356087. completeAllocationSetup (AllocationSetupCompleted in 0x8207c12f08678d1103ba8c76bcebae2ba2eae22c07f3486dff536b940c2b24bc, block 29313328; claimStart 1745416800) opened all allocations. claimIsOpen() is false at 29298732 and true at 29356087. Identity: runtime empty at 29289635; keccak 0x61a54ea99ce74a62e5fee62a31a22264bb2119dbb975efae4672284df9ef6a62 at 29289636 and 29356087. Source-3 (block 29289636, index 147) CREATE2s it from factory 0x0000000000ffe8b47b3e2130213b802212439497 (tx sender 0xbebe537efb8377629a1dfb1ac5c0568036e32712). hasClaimed makes source-1 the only possible claim of this allocation.

Reviewed loss. Source-1 receipt log 147: ZORA 0x1111111111166b7fe7bd91427724b487980afc69 Transfer from the claim contract to 0xb957ed2f of 5500777449190208000000000 (18 decimals). Valued at DefiLlama base ZORA 0.02346808 (quote time 1745501403).
